known_secrets.text: Certain injured animals placed near specific stone-marked ground recover faster than average.
These locations correspond loosely with old, unmaintained paths.
Some of these paths connect to the terraces near the old platform.
I've recorded this pattern but not reported it.
There is no accepted explanation in village medicine for this effect.
I suspect environmental factors we do not yet understand.
Some illnesses appear after exposure to specific forest zones.
Those zones overlap with areas Gopala avoids during certain seasons.
He says animals refuse those places.
